sources.title: ICS service notices and procedure pages
sources.note: Covers every ics.gov.et/information/* notice cited by the passport records. ICS publishes each change as a dated notice rather than editing one canonical page, so notices contradict each other and the newest is not always the one that ranks.

sources.title: Commercial Registration and Business Licensing Proclamation No. 980/2016
sources.publisher: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, via MoTRI
sources.note: Legal basis, not current procedure. Parts of it are amended by 1150/2019, so an article quoted from here may already be repealed.

sources.title: Commercial Registration and Business Licensing (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1150/2019
sources.publisher: Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, via MoTRI
sources.note: Amends 980/2016. Text extraction is poor on this scan, so treat any quoted wording as unreliable until read against the printed Negarit Gazeta.

sources.title: Fayda demographic data update and update centres
Ministry of Revenue
sources.note: Serves a valid Let's Encrypt leaf without the intermediate, so a strict client rejects the chain. The site is also a client-rendered application, so a plain fetch yields almost no text; it is registered for citation and reachability checking rather than for retrieval.

sources.title: eTax filing and payment portal
sources.note: Login-gated single-page application. Registered so that citations to the filing portal resolve to a vetted source; it yields no ingestable text.

sources.title: Tax Compliance Guide for Foreign Investors in Ethiopia
sources.note: Written for foreign investors but the taxpayer categories, schedules and payment periods it states are the general federal rules. Thresholds move with later proclamations, so figures need re-checking against the current law.
